Cipla Reports 39% Drop in Q1 Net Profit

Cipla's net profit for the first quarter fell by 39% year-on-year, reaching ₹785.55 crore. The company's performance was impacted by its North America business. Despite the dip, the Managing Director and Global CEO, Achin Gupta, expressed expectations of continued sequential growth in North America, citing the upcoming product pipeline as support. The company's stock saw a decline following the announcement.
